title: Keep the pump loop on its grid
hints: vTaskDelay(10) means "sleep 10 ticks from now", and "now" is already 2 ticks late. You want "wake at the previous wake time plus 10".
Declare `TickType_t last_wake = xTaskGetTickCount();` once, above the `for (;;)`. Then replace the delay with `xTaskDelayUntil(&last_wake, CONTROL_PERIOD)`, which advances `last_wake` for you.
The last line of the loop becomes `if (xTaskDelayUntil(&last_wake, CONTROL_PERIOD) == pdFALSE) g_overruns++;`.
